remarks: Welcome to Sunrise Hill! Beautifully updated, this 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo offers comfort, convenience, and a lifestyle you'll love. This home features an updated kitchen and bathrooms, new flooring on the main level, and new carpeting. The layout is both functional and inviting, with bright living spaces perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The second floor features an updated hall bath and two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space. The basement provides additional storage and includes a laundry area for added convenience. Step outside to your own private, fenced-in backyard, ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying a bit of outdoor space. Located in a desirable, commuter-friendly area, this home is just minutes from public transportation, schools, shopping, and everyday essentials. The community offers fantastic amenities including two tennis courts, two playgrounds, and a pool, making it easy to enjoy both an active and low-maintenance lifestyle. Don't miss this one!
